entries.00c45761bbd85d23: A category in which the Company manufactures, under contract, the products and active pharmaceutical ingredients of the equity-method affiliate EA Pharma Co., Ltd. (40.0% voting rights held). EA Pharma Co., Ltd. became an equity-method affiliate of the Company in 2016, when Ajinomoto Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. succeeded to part of Eisai Co., Ltd.'s business in the gastrointestinal disease field through a company split (absorption-type demerger); the Company leases buildings and other assets from it.

entries.12f9ff96d75262ce: The oils and fats category, carried out by the equity-method affiliate J-OIL MILLS, Inc. (27.2% voting rights held). It is the company into which the Company spun off its oils and fats business in 2001 and merged it with Ajinomoto Seiyu Co., Ltd.; it is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and files an [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]]. The Company purchases and sells its products and leases buildings and other assets to it.
entries.29dbe6fc9b0c3373: This product category sells, in various countries, umami seasoning "Ajinomoto®" as well as "Hondashi®," "Cook Do®," "Ajinomoto KK Consommé" and "Pure Select® Mayonnaise," along with flavor seasonings such as "Ros Dee®" in Thailand, "Masako®" in Indonesia, "Aji-ngon®" in Vietnam and "Sazon®" in Latin America. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥478,038 million (¥453,319 million in the previous year), the largest category within the Seasonings & Foods segment. Local subsidiaries in each country, including Ajinomoto Thailand, Ajinomoto Indonesia, Ajinomoto Vietnam, Ajinomoto Philippines, Ajinomoto Malaysia, Ajinomoto Foods Nigeria, Ajinomoto do Brasil and Ajinomoto Peru, handle manufacturing and sales.

entries.3204fe2d431ffae0: This segment earns revenue from selling seasonings and nutrition and processed foods to general consumers, and from providing services to the restaurant and food processing industries. It is the largest of the three reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥936,926 million (104.6% of the previous year) and segment profit (business profit) was ¥143,036 million (106.6% of the previous year). As reasons for the revenue increase, the company cites higher sales of seasonings in both Japan and overseas, a substantial revenue increase in nutrition and processed foods in Japan mainly due to the effect of higher unit prices, and a revenue increase overseas due to exchange rate effects and higher unit prices. It also states that Solutions & Ingredients recorded a revenue decrease, mainly due to lower sales of umami seasonings for processing. The number of employees is 22,316 (plus an annual average of 4,211 temporary employees), the largest among the reportable segments.

entries.40b29eb9c22a2a99: This product category is included in the Healthcare & Others segment and handles amino acids for animal feed, sports nutrition such as the supplement "Aminovital®," personal care ingredients such as the amino acid-based cleanser "Amisoft®," the makeup oil agent "Eldew®" and the powder "Amihope®," medical foods, and agricultural services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥92,665 million (¥104,195 million in the previous year). The company states that revenue decreased overall and profit decreased substantially overall owing to strategic expenditures, among other factors. It is handled by Ajinomoto Direct, Inc.

entries.7e5c52e0ef1e4162: This is a contract development and manufacturing service for pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients and others. It undertakes the manufacturing and development of pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients for pharmaceutical companies, and recognizes revenue at the point when completion of manufacturing and development is deemed to have occurred. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84,860 million (¥89,290 million in the previous year), and the company states that, excluding the impact of the sale of Ajinomoto Althea, Inc., revenue increased. Ajinomoto Omnichem in Belgium, Forge Biologics, a US CDMO for gene therapy drugs, and Gene Design, Inc. are responsible for this.

entries.853e0a4e8aecd633: This product category serves the restaurant and food processing industries. It handles umami seasoning "Ajinomoto®" for domestic restaurant and food processing use, seasonings and processed foods for restaurants, seasonings for processing (natural seasonings, enzyme preparation "Activa®"), boxed meals and prepared dishes, bakery products, nucleotide-based seasonings, and sweeteners such as aspartame for processing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥188,134 million (¥198,114 million in the previous year), and the company states that the decrease was mainly due to lower sales of umami seasonings for processing. It is handled by Ajinomoto Foods Europe, Ajinomoto Bakery, Inc. and Delica Ace, and Yamaki Co., Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate.

entries.c5757f5665437b73: This product category sells electronic materials such as interlayer insulation material for semiconductor packages "ABF™," functional materials such as adhesive "Plainset®" and magnetic material "AFTINNOVA® Magnetic Film," activated carbon, and release paper to customers in Japan and overseas. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥100,782 million (¥76,568 million in the previous year), the largest of the four product categories in the Healthcare & Others segment. The company states that revenue and profit increased substantially owing to strong sales of electronic materials. It is handled by Ajinomoto Fine-Techno Co., Inc., whose electronic materials and other manufacturing facilities have a book value of ¥22,087 million and which has 451 employees.

entries.e52cd8730e792e55: A segment that earns revenue mainly from sales of frozen foods. It handles dumplings ("Gyoza", "POT STICKERS", etc.), rice products ("The★® Chahan", "CHICKEN FRIED RICE", etc.), noodles ("YAKISOBA", "RAMEN", etc.), sweets (commercial-use cakes, "MACARON", etc.), shumai, and processed chicken products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥290,308 million (100.3% of the previous year); the company states that it was flat overall. It is carried out by Ajinomoto Frozen Foods Co., Inc., Ajinomoto Foods North America, Inc. and Ajinomoto Frozen Foods France; the revenue of Ajinomoto Foods North America, Inc. (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies) exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. The number of employees is 5,348 (plus an annual average of 3,343 temporary employees).

entries.f0abd39098dd7459: This segment handles amino acids for pharmaceutical and food use, contract development and manufacturing services (CDMO) for pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients, and electronic materials, and brings together the businesses other than food. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥341,504 million (104.0% of the previous year), making it the second largest reportable segment, ahead of the Frozen Foods segment. Segment profit (business profit) was ¥66,202 million (145.1% of the previous year), and the company cites the revenue increase effect of electronic materials and higher profit in Biopharma Services & Ingredients, among other reasons. Despite the impact of the sale of its subsidiary Ajinomoto Althea, revenue increased owing to strong sales of electronic materials. The number of employees is 5,219 (plus an annual average of 345 temporary employees).
